deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin interface and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
In the checkout settings, click on 'Additional scripts' under the 'Scripts and styles' section.
Paste the following code into the 'Add script tag' field: `<script src='https://example.com/returns-reason-form.js'></script>`
Replace `https://example.com/returns-reason-form.js` with the actual URL of your returns reason capture form script.
In the Shopify admin interface, navigate to Settings > Shipping and delivery > Returns.
Click on 'Add return policy' and select the store location where you want to add the returns policy.
In the 'Return policy details' section, click on the 'Edit' button next to 'Return reason'.
Select 'Custom form' as the return reason type and enter the following code in the 'Form HTML' field: `<form id='returns-reason-form'>...</form>`
Replace `...` with the actual HTML of your returns reason capture form.
In the Shopify admin interface, navigate to Settings > Shipping and delivery > Returns.
Click on the 'Save' button to save the return policy changes.
To test the returns reason capture form, initiate a return from the customer's account or from the order details page.
